title: Preserve all thermal interiors under the contour involution
statement: For conditioned core fields 0<=h_i<=3*phi, flipping every spin inside an embedded filled contour preserves core membership, including holes and islands. V<=(r+2)*P/4 gives weight ratio at most exp(-3*theta*P/2). The fixed-diagonal contour count is at most 8*(2P+3)^2*4^P. The supplied rational sum 1190681/121287375000 is below 1/100000. This uses actual physical perimeter and embedded lifts, not an FKG assumption or zero-edge energy.
